select T0.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/ acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr,
T0.ORDER_TYPE as type, /*收划款类型*/ to_char(T0.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as settleDat,/**收划款日期**/ T0.SETTLE_AMT as settleAmt,/**收划款金额**/ T0.CCY as ccyCode,/**交易币种Code**/ T0.CCY as ccy, /**币种**/ DECODE(T0.PS,'01',T4.ACCT_NAME,T5.ACCT_NAME)AS myAcctName, /**收款账户户名**/ DECODE(T0.PS,'01',T0.MY_ACCT_NO,T0.COUNTER_ACCT_NO) AS myAcctNo, /**收款账户账号**/ DECODE(T0.PS,'01',T5.ACCT_NAME,T4.ACCT_NAME) AS counterAcctName,/**付款账户户名**/ DECODE(T0.PS,'01',T0.COUNTER_ACCT_NO,T0.MY_ACCT_NO) AS counterAcctNo, /**付款账户账号**/ T0.SETTLE_STATUS AS status /**收划款状态**/ from STL_ORDERS T0 /**结算指令表**/ left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 on T0.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID /**金融产品交易表**/ inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on ( deal.BUSI_NO = T1.TRADE_ID OR deal.BUSI_NO = T0.ORDER_ID ) inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO T4 on T0.MY_ACCT_NO = T4.ACCT_NO /**清算账户表**/ left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO T5 on T0.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = T5.ACCT_NO /**清算账户表**/ where T0.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and T0.BUSI_TYPE = #{busiType} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
